selection_rationale: CAND-2026-GVE-01 (Generate–Verify–Emulate) best matches the verified gap (G1) for an end-to-end evaluate→verify→emulate benchmark, is experimentally falsifiable, directly relevant to CNSM NetOps safety, and balances novelty with feasible emulator/verifier implementation per the evidence and reviews. The candidate's design supports clear primary outcomes and diagnostic metrics while reviewer feedback provides actionable repairs to make the preregistration robust.
unresolved_uncertainties: Emulator external validity: how well selected Mininet/container scenarios map to production topologies and failure modes.
Deterministic verifier completeness: risk of verifier false negatives that understate residual operational harm.
LLM API variability and versioning: provider-side nondeterminism, drift, or outages affecting reproducibility.
Dataset representativeness and licensing for the public intent+config corpus.
Statistical power: whether N=200 tasks × replicates is sufficient to detect the prespecified >10 percentage-point effect under realistic variance assumptions.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Specify exact deterministic verifier (implementation, version) and enumerate its formal checks and known limits; provide acceptance criteria for verifier-generated repairs.
Provide a formal power/sample-size analysis justifying N=200 and replicate counts relative to the detectable effect (>10 percentage points) and preregister the calculation and sensitivity bounds.
Detail emulator topology recipes, deterministic configuration settings, fixed seeds, and reproducibility validation; publish emulator recipes, configuration hashes, and run scripts.
Lock and report exact LLM model identifier(s), API endpoints, versioning, and fallback/contingency plans for provider outages or quota limits; preregister the model-call budget and retry policy.

Pre-register randomization and pairing schemes, inclusion/exclusion rules, and a plan for handling unverifiable/partial LLM outputs (e.g., syntactic failures), including transparent logging and exclusion criteria.
